scientific_integrity: Exact analytic all-n proof supplemented by 2590 finite numerical checks; does not claim those checks prove the theorem or that its ecological extension is field-verified.
scientific_limitations: Idealized destination-only two-neighbor cyclic kernel; route-dependent Gamma rate extension; not necessarily a semigroup; no field calibration, robust estimation or real movement reversal claimed. Broad priority and external validation remain open.
title: Destination preferences cannot reverse gamma-conditioned habitat circulation, but observation time can reverse it twice
